# 1980s–2010s: The Long scar

Heather was nine years old when the diagnosis arrived. The routine checkup had become something other than routine—the blood test that showed results that should not have been possible, the referral to the specialist, the office visit where words like "aplastic anemia" and "bone marrow failure" were spoken with a gravity that no parent should ever have to hear.
